newsitem.title: DUBAI: Rain inflicts $24 million in damages on Saudi.
newsitem.headline: Rain inflicts $24 million in damages on Saudi.

text.p: Week-long freak rain storms and gale winds that hit Saudi Arabia's Red Sea coastal areas last month have wrought 90 million riyals ($24 million) in damages, Saudi newspapers reported on Tuesday.
Heavy rainfall killed at least three people, cut off many villages, swept away several homes and cars and disconnected about 21,000 telephone lines in the area.
Saudi insurance companies have decided to include car damages inflicted by "natural disasters", including rain, in comprehensive auto insurance offers, the papers added.
Saudis prayed for rain across the parched kingdom last month in response to an appeal by King Fahd.
